verses.text: Of David. Do not get upset because of evil people. Do not be jealous of those who do wrong.
They will soon dry up like grass. They will wither like green plants.
Trust in the LORD and do good. Live in the land and enjoy safe pasture.
Find your joy in the LORD, and he will give you what your heart wants.
Give everything you do to the LORD. Trust in him, and he will do this:
He will make your goodness shine like the dawn, and the justice of your cause like the noonday sun.
Be still in front of the LORD and wait patiently for him. Do not get upset when others succeed, or when people carry out their evil plans.
Stop being angry and turn away from rage. Do not get upset. It only leads to evil.
Evil people will be destroyed, but those who wait for the LORD will receive the land.
In a little while the wicked will be gone. You will look for them, but they will not be there.
But humble people will receive the land and enjoy great peace.
Wicked people plot against good people and grind their teeth at them.
But the Lord laughs at the wicked, because he knows their day is coming.
The wicked pull out their swords and bend their bows to bring down the poor and needy, to kill those who live honestly.
But their swords will stab their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
The little that good people have is better than the riches of many wicked people.
The power of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD holds up good people.
The LORD watches over the lives of blameless people. What they receive will last forever.
They will not be put to shame in bad times. Even in times of famine they will have plenty.
But wicked people will die. The LORD's enemies will be like flowers in the fields. They will disappear like smoke.
Wicked people borrow and do not pay back, but good people give generously.
Those the LORD blesses will receive the land, but those he curses will be destroyed.
The LORD makes a person's steps firm when he is pleased with the way that person lives.
Even if they trip, they will not fall down, because the LORD holds their hand.
I was young and now I am old, yet I have never seen good people abandoned, or their children begging for bread.
They are always generous and lend freely. Their children are a blessing.
Turn away from evil and do good. Then you will live safely forever.
The LORD loves justice, and he will not leave his faithful people. They will be protected forever, but the children of the wicked will be destroyed.
Good people will receive the land and live in it forever.
Good people speak words of wisdom. Their tongues speak what is fair.
The law of their God is in their hearts. Their feet do not slip.
Wicked people watch for good people, looking for a chance to kill them.
But the LORD will not leave good people in their power or let them be found guilty when they are put on trial.
Wait for the LORD and follow his way. He will honour you by giving you the land. You will see the wicked destroyed.
I have seen a wicked and powerful person spreading out like a green tree in its own soil.
But he soon passed away and was gone. I looked for him, but he could not be found.
Look at blameless people and watch honest people. There is a future for those who make peace.
But all sinners will be destroyed. The future of the wicked will be cut off.
The LORD saves good people. He is their fortress in times of trouble.
The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they go to him for safety.
